title: Positive exactness of a small-valued injective presheaf Cech complex
statement: theorem small_injective_presheaf_cech_exact {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [HasFiniteWidePullbacks C] (P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v}) [Injective P] (X : C) {ι : Type v} (U : ι → C) (π : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X) (q : ℕ) : ((cechComplexFunctor (fun i ↦ Over.mk (π i))).obj ((Over.forget X).op ⋙ P)).ExactAt (q + 1)

proof.text: Construct the small free abelian presheaf chains of the categorical products. Their positive-degree exactness is lem-sc-small-cech-free-exact. The free Yoneda additive equivalences and their differential compatibility are lem-sc-small-cech-free-comparison.

Translate a cocycle c in degree q+1 via the inverse additive equivalence to a morphism a:K_(q+1)->P killing K_(q+2)->K_(q+1). Apply ShortComplex.Exact.descToInjective to the exact adjacent chain short complex. Its comp_descToInjective identity gives a:K_(q+1)->P as the boundary precomposition of the extended map K_q->P. Translate that map back to degree q, use differential compatibility, and apply the inverse identity of the additive equivalence. ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff now gives the original ExactAt assertion.

proof_origin.place: Injective-presheaf argument using Tags 03AS and 03AT; Lean reduction by S2
